title: Fully procedural animals for three.js, built with Opus 5.5
author: MajidManzarpour
selftext:
**Releasing three.js Procedural Animals 🐾**  
  
24 species generated entirely from code with Opus 5.5: no models, no textures, no hand-made rigs.   
  
Each one is sculpted from SDFs, meshed, rigged, skinned and furred at runtime, then animated with IK.  
  
Open source, agent ready 👇

Demo [https://majidmanzarpour.github.io/threejs-procedural-animals/](https://majidmanzarpour.github.io/threejs-procedural-animals/)  
  
Source [https://github.com/majidmanzarpour/threejs-procedural-animals](https://github.com/majidmanzarpour/threejs-procedural-animals)

replies.author: No-Marionberry-772
replies.body:
thats quite a take.  There are definitely rough edges, its a good proof of concept, not ready for real world work.

Personally, I wouldn't release this just yet, but a little more work, some optimization, some effort put into making it not pre-defined species but a generalized solution for creating skinned meshes for arbitrary topologies, its a good idea.

comments.author: blueeetherabbit
comments.body:
It's rough but it's not a bad start, I also question if you were too happy to rush your release. 

[Also looks like someone literally just posted something very similar](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/s/q9cDdOikhb) maybe look at what they're doing and see if you have any ways to improve or maybe y'all just team up and open source the procedural engine together.

comments.author: No-Marionberry-772
comments.body:
You should work to pull the body plan specifications out of code, and generalize the creature creation.  That way creating new creatures and body plans is a focused effort for consumers.

Additionally, I'd suggest setting it up to export skinned meshes with rigs so that the resulting creatures can be used in any environment.  Those two things would make it far more useful.

Fine structures like bird legs are not well constructed. Look at using adaptive voxelizations for fine structures so you can represent smaller creatures which need more finer details.

replies.author: MajidManzarpour
replies.body: Thanks, there is an authoring guide for building additional animals in the docs/ folder and you can bake the results. Will look into standardizing it more!

replies.author: MajidManzarpour
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback, if you have any suggestions lmk!
